# FRC Team 4550 "Something's Bruin"

## Who we are
FRC Team 4550 is a FIRST Robotics Competition team from Cherry Creek High School in Greenwood Village, Colorado. We build competition robots, compete in FRC events, and promote STEM education through community outreach.

## Key pages
- Home: https://4550robotics.com/
- Media Gallery: https://4550robotics.com/media
- Privacy Policy: https://4550robotics.com/privacy
- Terms & Conditions: https://4550robotics.com/terms
- Member Hub (restricted): https://4550robotics.com/member-hub

## Summary
FRC (FIRST Robotics Competition) Team 4550 "Something's Bruin" has been competing since 2012 with 40-50 student members across three sub-teams: Build, Programming, and Marketing & Outreach. The team made it to the World Championship in 2016. We are based at Cherry Creek High School in Greenwood Village, Colorado.
